name: B
rationale: Transverse power-first floorplan. Rigid90-degree U2/L2/C20/C21 cell shortens source-to-input placement while the MCU shifts10.5mm down/.6mm left. C22 and EN/PS parts are intentionally repacked. Flash/pullups/bypass and crystal/load-cap subgroups retain their internal relative geometry. Right-side local bypasses remain close but their pin-to-cap spans grow by up to about.6mm to reserve a wider analog exit corridor.
